calls.reason: On the 2026 earnings calls Musk said autonomous humanoids are unachieved and the AI architecture is still being worked out, but he expected a fix by about 2027. That reads as admitting hard work, not limits well beyond current grasp, and the forecast has no deadline.

Ars Technica says Optimus walked unsteadily, waved, and that a second unit needed a stand and slumped. Boston Dynamics had already shown Atlas running an obstacle course with vaults and backflips in 2021. That is a clear lead in demonstrated movement.
